title: Inzwi Risina Kuteererwa reMazana Emakore
intro: Munguva refu maguta makuru asati amuka, mweya wega wakasimuka pakati pevanhu vakanga vasiya chokwadi. Kuoma kwavo kwaienderana chete nekushivirira kwemunhu uyu aidaidza ari ega, uyo akakumbira muzvizvarwa zvakawanda asingarasikirwe nepfungwa dzake. Nyevero dzese padzakawira pasi, kurangarira kusati kwamboitika kwakachinja nyika pachayo. Nhasi, manzwi enyaya iyoyo achiri kunzwika mukuverenga kwega kwega. Unogona kuziva mweya uyu wakatsunga here?
clues: Ndakakurira pakati pevanhu vainamata zvifananidzo zvenhema uye vaifuratira zviratidzo zvaivapoteredza, asi ndakasarudzwa kuti ndivamutse kubva pakusateerera kwavo.
Ndakadana vanhu vangu kakawanda, asi vakandipomera mhosva yekuti ndiri munhu akafanana navo, vachiseka shoko rangu uye vachivhara nzeve dzavo.
Usiku nemasikati, ndakavakumbira neuchenjeri uye zviyeuchidzo zvinyoro, asi mashoko angu airatidzika kunge anyangarika, asina kunzwiwa uye asina kuteererwa.
Ndichitungamirirwa naMwari, ndakavaka chikepe chikuru chematanda nemapuranga panyika yakaoma, uye vanhu vangu vakandiseka semunhu akanga asina pfungwa.
Mafashamo makuru paakauya sezvakavimbiswa, mwanakomana wangu akaramba kukwira muchikepe neni, achitenda kuti gomo raizomudzivirira kubva mumvura yaikwira.
Ndakava tateguru wekutanga patsva panyika, uye nyaya yangu yakachengetedzwa muchitsauko cheKorani chine zita rangu chairo.
